prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 14 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows behind the desk.
Image 1: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT (25)
Image 3: the character sheet of BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT (27)
Image 4: the character sheet of GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT (26)
Image 5: the character sheet of SHIRTLESS APPLICANT (28), look S0
Image 6: the character sheet of SHIRTLESS APPLICANT (28), look S1
Image 7: the character sheet of Xu Banxia (24)
Image 8: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S1
Image 9: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 10: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 11: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 12: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 13: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 14: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 15: the prop small dumbbell; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran sits back in the one high-backed black leather chair behind the walnut executive desk, her hand flicked toward the open floor. The four applicants stand in one row on the open pale-oak floor in front of the desk, facing her: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT with the small dumbbell at the seating-area end, BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, and SHIRTLESS APPLICANT, still in his yellow T-shirt, nearest the walnut door on the right wall. Xu Banxia stands at the door-side corner of the desk. The tan leather sofa, two armchairs and the marble coffee table stand at the left-wall shelving. The camera stays on the seating-area side of the axis between the desk and the row of applicants.
Panel 1: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, from the seating-area side, facing the seating-area end of the row. GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT curls the small lilac dumbbell with both hands, his face red and straining theatrically. BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT stands beside him.
Panel 2: Medium shot, quick push in, low angle, from the seating-area side, facing the middle of the row. BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT throws a stiff, awkward punch at the air toward the desk and wobbles.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the seating-area side, facing the door end of the row. GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT wrestles his tucked-in grey shirt up out of his slacks to bare his thin stomach. SHIRTLESS APPLICANT stands beside him.
Panel 4: Medium shot, quick tilt up, eye level, from the seating-area side, facing the walnut-door end of the row. SHIRTLESS APPLICANT pulls his yellow T-shirt off over his head and drops it on the floor at his feet, now bare-chested with an oiled torso.
Panel 5: Medium close-up, slow push in, low angle, from the seating-area side, facing the walnut-door end of the row. Bare-chested SHIRTLESS APPLICANT flexes both biceps, rolls his eyes half shut and licks his lips at the desk.
Panel 6: Close-up, locked-off camera, high angle, from the seating-area side, on the arms of the black leather chair. Ji Ran's hands clench the padded arms of the leather chair, knuckles tightening.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the seating-area side, facing the desk. Ji Ran presses one hand over her forehead and shuts her eyes in the leather chair.
Panel 8: Medium shot, handheld camera, eye level, dirty single from the seating-area side, facing the door-side corner of the desk, the edge of Ji Ran's chair and shoulder in the foreground. Xu Banxia hides her blushing face behind one hand, peeks through her fingers and bends toward Ji Ran.
Panel 9: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the seating-area side, facing the desk. Ji Ran waves her hand in front of her face, eyes squeezed half shut, shaking her head.
Panel 10: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, clean single from the seating-area side, on the door-side corner of the desk. Xu Banxia nods quickly, lips pressed against a giggle.
Panel 11: Wide shot, pan following Ji Ran from the desk to the walnut door, eye level, from the seating-area side. Ji Ran rises from the leather chair and strides across the open floor past the row of applicants toward the walnut door; the applicants turn their heads after her and Xu Banxia stays at the desk corner.
Panel 12: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the seating-area side, on the frame of the walnut door. A wet hand slaps onto the walnut doorframe and braces against it; the denim sleeve of Lin Qingyu drips with rain.
Panel 13: Medium shot, slow push in, low angle, from the seating-area side, facing the walnut door. Lin Qingyu leans against the doorframe in his open light-blue denim jacket and damp white T-shirt, hair wet, face beaded with sweat, chest heaving, and looks up at Ji Ran with a boyish smile.
Panel 14: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, over-the-shoulder shot from the seating-area side past Lin Qingyu's shoulder at the doorframe, facing Ji Ran. Ji Ran stops short on the open floor a step from the walnut door, her eyes widening as she takes in Lin Qingyu; behind her the bare-chested SHIRTLESS APPLICANT stands at the door end of the row.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
